intro: Before you go. Look at it with me for a moment -- the game is only half of it.
outro: Good. Don't try to remember all of it. Remember one thing and mean it.

big_swing: Move {move}. Look at the board here, and then look at where it ended. {points}. I am not going to tell you what happened in between. Find it.
atari_ignored: Move {move}. This group has one liberty. Look at it. Now -- what were you thinking about instead? {again}
Move {move}. {liberty} was empty. I want you to tell me what you were looking at when you played {played}. {again}
capture_missed: Move {move}. {stones} of mine on one liberty. You were looking at the other side of the board. Was it bigger?
died_savable: Move {move}. {save} would have saved it. You had seen the danger by then, I think, and answered the wrong half of it.
own_eye_filled: Move {move}. You filled your own eye. How many eyes does a group need? And how many did you have?
self_atari: Move {move}. {stones}, one liberty. Ask yourself what you expected to happen next -- not what did happen, what you expected.
dead_group_fed: Move {move}. {stones} more stones into a group with one liberty. What were you hoping for? Say it out loud -- that is the habit, not the move.
filled_own_territory: Move {move}. Count your own area, then count it again after those {stones}. Where did the difference go? Nowhere. You covered it up.
cut_ignored: Move {move}. Your stones were one group and then they were two. Which half were you defending when you played {played}? Were you defending either?
ladder_failed: Move {move}. You ran, and kept running. A ladder is the one thing in Go you can read to the end with certainty. Why didn't you?
should_have_passed: Move {move}. Was there anything left on this board worth a stone? {stones} more went down. Passing is a move. It is often the best one.
good_capture: Move {move}. {stones}. Do you know why it worked? Sit with that before you answer.
good_save: Move {move}. You got the group out. What did you see there that you had not been seeing?
atari_answered: Move {move}. You were in atari and you answered it. Good. Now -- did you see it, or did you feel it? There is a difference and it matters later.
best_moment: Move {move}. That is the strongest move you played. {points}. I want you to look at it until you can say why -- not now, later, on the tram.
nothing_broke: I have nothing to show you. That is not nothing: it means you looked at your own groups every move, all game. Notice that you did that.

unqualified: No. You have passed me in this, and a teacher who keeps teaching past that point is protecting herself, not you.
I will tell you what I admired. Then you should find somebody who can still beat you.
